workload: Receive a CRM webhook, call the authoritative customer service, and notify the account channel.
blocker_handling: Tenant authorization and writes remain in the versioned customer API.

contracts.validation_failure: Reject without side effects and route a redacted event to the error workflow.

reliability.idempotency_key: provider event ID plus tenant ID
reliability.partial_failure: The API write is authoritative; notification failure is reconciled independently.

operations.rollback: Disable the workflow and restore the last reviewed export.
operations.kill_switch: Deactivate customer-sync in the protected production instance.

cost.expected_volume: Measure approved daily webhook forecast before activation.
cost.burst_volume: Bound by ingress rate limit and worker concurrency.
cost.hard_cap: Provider and workflow concurrency caps must be recorded before activation.
